page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is an enterprise-scale, memory-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CL processors, it delivers 208 virtual central processing units (vCPUs) paired with 3,072 GB of RAM. The server operates using KVM virtualization and provides a memory density of approximately 14.77 GB per vCPU core, targeting memory-intensive enterprise operations that require massive system memory pools.

The ecs.re6.52xlarge instance does not include bundled local disk storage, requiring reliance on remote network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting network-bound data synchronization and distributed cache deployments. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost efficiency perspective, this hardware profile consolidates memory capacity into a single virtual node, minimizing the overhead of scaling across multiple smaller instances for large in-memory datasets. However, the absence of local NVMe storage necessitates evaluation of network storage latency for I/O-heavy applications. This instance is suitable for enterprise in-memory relational databases, SAP HANA deployments, real-time analytics engines, and high-capacity data caching systems.
